issue.title: fix: distDir in verifyTypeScriptSetup for nextLint
issue.body:
fixes #46611 

this PR fixed customer dist type(`distDir` option in next.config.js) in `tsconfig.json` will be a hard coded absolute path issue which is a bug from PR #46249 
since dist type only be added when user using app dir, to reproduce this issue you need to make `app dir` toggle on and add a `distDir` option in `next.config.js` file
